The name Yovonnda carries the meaning “God's grace, beautiful dove” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Yovonnda usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, beautiful dove and live with faith, good character and purpose.
